round_question: Can the presentation layer still present a killed invention as a success, a NOT_A_SURVIVOR package as downloadable, conceptual geometry as engineering geometry, a not-attempted render as an engineering failure or a success, the legacy Blender path as implicitly selectable, a conceptual run as an OCP payer, or a forensics line without a commit identity — and does the fully valid positive path still present honestly?
answer: NO on every axis — measured by batteries: the killed invention is suppressed at the projection authority (challenge verdict > final_status, INVENTION_KILLED_BY_CHALLENGE typed, positive survivor control intact); a NOT_A_SURVIVOR verdict blocks EVERY ZIP route (409 typed, records disagreement surfaced, never hidden); the geometry-authority claim is DERIVED from what actually ran (CadQuery/OCCT only when a STEP exists; the conceptual path names the trimesh builder); the render availability notice derives the authority phrase, renders the NOT_ATTEMPTED branch, and never throws; the legacy Blender path is explicit-only with the LXIV record renewed and the overdue deletion escalated; CadQuery/OCP is lazily imported (bridge import crosses no OCP boundary; an engineering build does — the positive control); and every forensics line resolves its engine commit from the build artifact. The positive path still reaches VISUAL_READY through the sovereign chain.
